items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Al Adams. But the bands before that is what we can't think of. [INTERVIEWEE] They just won't stay in my mind.

ctx.x: Wouldn't have to be the most outstanding. We can get back to that part.
Yeah, if we can just get some names down. Now, later came George Brown and Al Adams, but this is in the early '40s. But before that there had to be some bands in Los Angeles.
